Rayan commands:

1. **/aiqa-setup** — one-time project bootstrap (guide, index, DB tables)
2. **/aiqa-writetestcases <story>** — Prompt 2: story → test-case Markdown
3. **/aiqa-executetests <test-file>** — Prompt 1: run cases with Playwright MCP (browser visible)
4. **/aiqa-fixbug <bug-file>** — Prompt 3: fix one bug
5. **/aiqa-fullworkflow <story>** — chain all of the above
6. **/aiqa-executetests --summary** — final restore check + SUMMARY.md
Run /aiqa-writetestcases <story-file>, review the files, then /aiqa-executetests <test-file> for each file.
Check test-results/bugs/BUGS-INDEX.md. Fix one with /aiqa-fixbug <bug-file>, then re-run the file with /aiqa-executetests.
Say 'run headless' / use /aiqa-executetests <file> --headless. Default is a visible browser.
